expectations: offline support for actions other than favorite/unfavorite
notifying the reader about dropped changes
context: constraint: new client state follows the injected Redux slice pattern, persisted via redux-persist
constraint: routing and API access conventions from CLAUDE.md
intent: Keep favorite/unfavorite working offline with a persisted queue and a header count, synced on reconnect

decisions.decision: networkMode always on both favorite mutations
decisions.why: default online mode pauses offline mutations so onError never fires

decisions.decision: Queue is an injected slice in entities/favorite-queue
decisions.why: both mutation features write it and cannot import siblings; root persist has no whitelist so it persists free

decisions.decision: Replay in features/favorite-sync, started from BootstrappedRouter after rehydration
decisions.why: launch catch-up must wait for rehydrate; replay needs no component
keeps the entity free of a session import

plan.summary: Offline favorites via persisted queue slice, network-error branch in both mutations, online/launch replay, header count
plan.key_finding: React Query pauses mutations offline, so networkMode always is required for any offline queueing

approach: Keep the optimistic change when a favorite gets no response and enqueue it in a persisted injected slice. A sync service replays the queue in order on online and on launch, and the header shows the count.
